scope: April-July 2015 LPB / Sun Park creditor-enforcement / HAYA / Uría chronology
publication_rule: Do not infer a client, retainer, instruction, title or conflict from institutional proximity or reported communication. Preserve contradictory evidence prominently.

events.statement: A native contemporaneous Sun Park-side email records the sender's report that HAYA had asked the local lawyer for case material to pass to Uría Madrid and that Javier González later communicated about continuing the proceeding.
events.proves: A contemporaneous report placing HAYA, Uría Madrid and Javier González in the enforcement information-flow chronology.
events.does_not_prove: The native HAYA instruction/transmission, Uría's client, a retainer, matter number, authority to instruct the local lawyer, or legal title to the credit.

events.statement: After speaking with Uría, Cuatrecasas reported that Uría did not yet have instructions to take any action on behalf of HAYA.
events.proves: Material contemporaneous counter-evidence against treating a HAYA mandate as established on 30 April 2015.
events.does_not_prove: That no later HAYA instruction or engagement was ever opened.

events.statement: Cuatrecasas reported that the local lawyer confirmed acting in the relevant proceedings for SAREB rather than Bankia.
events.proves: A contemporaneous capacity report relevant to separating creditor, servicer and counsel roles.
events.does_not_prove: The native power/appearance, asset-specific assignment, servicing mandate or final legal ownership.

events.statement: A preserved contemporaneous communication reports that the Administrador Concursal had spoken with Javier Rubio Sanz of Uría Menéndez.
events.does_not_prove: That Uría represented the Administrador Concursal, the client identity, retainer, mandate, subject matter or information exchanged.

relationships.label: case-material path reported; HAYA mandate explicitly not established on 30 Apr
